description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover exact brand colors: Dark (#141413), Light (#faf9f5), Mid Gray (#b0aea5), Light Gray (#e8e6dc), Orange (#d97757), Blue (#6a9bcc), Green (#788c5d). 2. Agent opens board_pitch_draft.pptx using python-pptx and iterates over all slides, shapes, and text runs. 3. For typography: all text runs at 24pt OR ABOVE get Poppins (or Arial fallback); all runs below 24pt get Lora (or Georgia fallback). The boundary case at exactly 24pt on Slide 3 must be handled correctly as a heading. 4. For text color: agent applies smart color selection — on dark backgrounds text becomes #faf9f5 (light), on light backgrounds text becomes #141413 (dark). 5. For non-text shapes (rectangles, decorative elements): agent cycles through accent colors orange→blue→green in order, replacing the existing wrong colors. 6. The result is saved as board_pitch_branded.pptx. The proprietary traps are: (a) exact hex values for all 7 brand colors, (b) the 24pt heading threshold (not 18pt or 20pt), (c) the specific cycling order orange→blue→green for accents, and (d) smart background-aware text color selection.
